claims.evidence: Photo 2 panel text reads 'SHARP AR-9201', not AR-M201; seller's stated model does not match the witness's reading.
No usage history, page counter, or wear indicators visible in the photos.
No power-on, copy output, or scan test shown; only a static lid-open/closed view.
Statement is cut off and no supporting photo of packaging, accessories, or readiness exists.

risks.risk: Model identity mismatch (seller says AR-M201, panel shows AR-9201) could mean wrong specs, wrong parts compatibility, or misrepresentation.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo or video of the model/serial label matching seller's claimed model.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lower-spec/uncertain model (AR-9201) per witness reading, not the seller's claimed model

risks.risk: Unknown working condition (no power-on or copy test).
risks.proof: Video of the unit powering on and producing a test copy/print.

risks.risk: Toner and drum consumable levels unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of toner/drum status screen or a fresh print sample showing print quality.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming consumables need full replacement

risks.risk: Page count / usage history unknown, affecting wear estimate.
risks.proof: Photo of the internal page counter or maintenance sticker.
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used/high page count

risks.risk: Missing trays, cables, or accessories not shown.
risks.proof: Full-unit photo showing all trays, power cable, and any document feeder attachments.

risks.risk: Hidden internal damage (wiring, rollers, fuser) not visible externally.
risks.proof: Video of internal compartments opened, including fuser and feed rollers.

proof_requests: Close-up photo/video of the model and serial number label matching the seller's claimed model
Video of the copier powering on and producing a test copy
Photo of toner/drum level indicator or a fresh print sample
Photo of the internal page/usage counter
Full-unit photo showing all trays, cables, and accessories included
Video of internal panel opened to check rollers and fuser
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Sharp photocopier, but the seller's claimed model conflicts with the panel reading and functionality is unverified, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
